description: This file defines classes and functions for browser test port configurations, including overrides for Linux, Mac, and Windows platforms, used in layout tests within the WebKit project.

classes.name: BrowserTestPortOverrides
classes.description: Base class providing default implementations and overrides for browser test platform ports.

classes.name: BrowserTestLinuxPort
classes.description: Linux-specific port class inheriting overrides from BrowserTestPortOverrides.

classes.name: BrowserTestMacPort
classes.description: Mac-specific port class inheriting overrides from BrowserTestPortOverrides.

classes.name: BrowserTestWinPort
classes.description: Windows-specific port class inheriting overrides from BrowserTestPortOverrides.

methods.name: get_port_class_name
methods.description: Returns the class name of the port based on the provided port name string.

methods.name: _driver_class
methods.description: Returns the class used for the browser test driver.

methods.name: layout_tests_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for layout tests, overridden to a specific path.

methods.name: check_sys_deps
methods.description: Stub method that simulates checking system dependencies, always returns OK.

methods.name: driver_name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the driver.

methods.name: default_timeout_ms
methods.description: Calculates and returns the default timeout in milliseconds, adjusted for debug configuration.

methods.name: virtual_test_suites
methods.description: Returns an empty list of virtual test suites.

methods.name: _path_to_driver
methods.description: Constructs the path to the driver executable, specific to Mac port.
